videoWorkflow.name: Reference-led video production
videoWorkflow.source: RD - AI Content System, owner-supplied 85-page PDF reviewed 13 October 2026
videoWorkflow.status: Workflow defined; creative execution bridge not yet connected
videoWorkflow.billing: Claude/Codex plan shots through monthly CLI subscriptions. Image/video renders use an approved tool allowance separately; a text-model subscription is not a video-generation entitlement.

steps.output: Client-scoped concept, audience, objective and delivery format. Select text-to-video for loose concepts, image-to-video for exact composition, or mapped references for several fixed elements.
Reference manifest: asset ID, version, approval, controlled element, ignored elements and priority. Real boat/product geometry is protected; every reference has a single responsibility.
Shot list with duration, framing, one main action, dominant camera movement, secondary motion, audio and continuity. Separate image appearance from motion instructions.

steps.tool: Existing image tool, approval required before generation
steps.output: Source-frame readiness check: correct geometry and composition, movement space, identity, styling and lighting. Fix a weak starting frame before animation.

steps.tool: Higgsfield plan; supported worker access to verify
steps.output: Generation job with exact source order, selected available video model, parameters, credit ceiling and saved result. No automatic model/API billing fallback.

steps.tool: FFmpeg; Remotion candidate for motion graphics
steps.output: Editable cut/timeline manifest, overlays, captions, soundtrack provenance, rendered preview and downloadable source package. Generation and editing are separate stages.

steps.tool: Full-clip inspection, ffprobe and saved evidence
steps.output: Check beginning/middle/end, identity, geometry, motion, camera, pacing, continuity, sound, aspect ratio and duration. A good first frame is insufficient. Report the dominant failure.

Save draft and exact-version approval request. Revise one failed variable while protecting successful elements; bounded attempts and stop before further credit use. Publication and client delivery require owner approval.

learningRecord: Source asset versions and reference responsibilities
Prompt and render parameters for each attempt
gaps: The PDF-linked separate Seedance Master Prompt Guide was not supplied or reviewed; the PDF does not contain the complete referenced guide.
Provider/model names in the PDF are examples, not verified current account availability. Resolve tools from the live catalogue before a render.
No Magnific subscription is needed for the initial stack. Alternative engines remain optional.
Paid generation, render worker dispatch and media-version review still need a controlled end-to-end test.

founderOsFindings.name: Separate coordinator chat from deliverable tasks
founderOsFindings.action: Add a persistent owner/COO conversation and distinct parent/child task records; never count the chat lane as completed work.

founderOsFindings.name: Use a private bridge to Paperclip
founderOsFindings.action: Implemented a server-side read bridge; the browser receives a safe projection without adapter credentials or prompts. Remote board authentication is separate from model API billing.

founderOsFindings.name: Make outages and uncertain runs visible
founderOsFindings.action: Implemented a 30-second read cooldown and unknown outage state. Uncertain model work still requires reconciliation before retry.

founderOsFindings.name: Keep schedules and outbound actions independently gated
founderOsFindings.action: Assigned internal work can run; proactive suggestions can be enabled separately. Publishing, spend and client delivery remain version-specific owner decisions.

founderOsFindings.name: Borrow patterns, keep the current Jarvis stack
founderOsFindings.action: Current Founder OS is Go/Svelte/Postgres/Elixir; do not replace Jarvis to obtain an orchestration connector. Its MIT connector can be studied independently; no source copied into the app.

modelAvailabilityNotes: Codex gpt-5.6-sol passed through Paperclip. Both gpt-6-sol and gpt-6.1-sol were rejected by the ChatGPT subscription despite catalog listings. Newer alternatives remain disabled.

Claude Opus completed the real COO plan and synthesis; Sonnet and Haiku passed subscription execution checks. Actual observed models: Opus 5, Sonnet 5 and Haiku 4.5. Alias resolution depends on the account.
Roles share monthly subscription limits. One-use saved run receipts block unrequested recovery model calls. Registered tools still need independent delivery evidence.

departmentDecision.principle: One primary workflow and at most one quality layer per task; tools and source context must be verified separately.

skillSelectionNotes: One primary workflow plus at most one quality layer. No whole skill pack loaded into every agent.
Humanizer editing follows approved client voice; examples are omitted from injected context to limit token overhead.
MC art-direction guidance overrides blanket aesthetic bans. Visual review requires actual rendered output.
Nano Banana Pro is verified through Higgsfield model discovery; no Gemini API key or automatic paid render.
Video editing guidance is installed; direct local fixture export passed. An Office media-dispatch broker remains a separate delivery gate.

toolBridge.scope: Only a saved active model run and its role-specific grants. No raw shell, arbitrary file paths, publication, deployment or paid generation.

merges.reason: Capacity belongs with deadlines, dependencies and delivery coordination.
Format adaptation belongs with the original copy and channel brief.
Receipt extraction and source linking belong with reconciliation.
Cash forecasting and profitability share the same recorded financial evidence.
AI usage and model costs belong with software spend and renewals.
Asset tags, rights and provenance belong with the shared asset library.
Reusable methods and reviewed lessons need one version owner.
Tool research should end in an evidence-based evaluation, not a separate digest.
